column1: # mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS LinkML classes and Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) event classes and objects. Enables zero-translation ingestion of SIEM alerts (in OCSF format) into ISMS incident records.

column10: OCSF security finding aligns with ISMS event record
OCSF incident-finding category aligns with ISMS incident
Asset of type device aligns with OCSF device object
Role often realised as OCSF user object with role attribute
Risk references vulnerabilities tracked as OCSF objects
OCSF compliance object references control identifiers
Event timestamp slot maps to OCSF time
Detection method informed by OCSF observables
Severity slot aligns with OCSF severity enum
Incident category corresponds to OCSF category_uid
Affected assets often referenced as OCSF device objects
Evidence collection aligns with OCSF evidences object
